**Management Summary – Project LV 262,260 €**

The tender contains numerous specification gaps that expose the client to cost overruns, contractual disputes and compliance risks. Key issues: unit price for earthworks (2.1.1.40) is 5‑times the reference range, yet lacks soil class, depth and profile data; duplicate and undefined site‑establishment items (2.1.1.10, 2.1.4.50) risk double billing. Several core trades are missing technical details—shaft (2.1.2.40), gate valve (2.1.2.40), masonry (2.1.3.10), paving (2.1.3.60), asphalt (2.1.3.90), insulation (2.1.3.40) and waste disposal (2.1.1.50, 2.1.4.90). Empty descriptions (2.1.3.30) render positions non‑enforceable under VOB/A. Immediate corrective action: revise specifications, align unit prices with DIN references, eliminate duplicates, and provide complete technical data to secure reliable estimating and contract compliance.
